name: Crowex Octane 'Orca'
summary: A luxury watch that IGN lists as one of the three Key Valuables at the Kingpin Bowling Illegal Operation.
body: IGN names the Crowex Octane 'Orca' as a luxury watch and the third Key Valuable at Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates operation in Port Gellhorn.

IGN places it on a small table in the corner of the room to the left of the bowling lanes, on the south side of the building as seen on the map, with a Zombix and 552 dollars on the middle table of that room.
PowerPyx, as cited in the app's watch entry, places Kingpin Bowling's watch in an office; IGN's office holds the safe instead.

body: IGN lists the Gold Nicky McVee card in the Vice City Narcos set, a basketball set of 24 cards and one of 18 collectible card sets.
IGN's directions place it in Ocean Beach, naming Beach Rose Apartments and Harborside Ave.
IGN says cards can be kept in a box at the safehouse and sold at any pawn shop, where a card's colour and rarity decide its price.
